question: T12 (task-acaf80752e67e86d, task-8493ffbc4169c73c): a press on a Scrolling block's Link row while it holds Attach link, its link editor open; and the block toolbar of a Scrolling block. On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, each scenario in its own edit session: a new section, a new Scrolling block, Edit, Content (CT: the block only selected). P1: Attach link, the About page picked in the list (the editor stays open on /about, the row reads Attach link), a press on the row's Attach link, then Escape. P2: the same pick and press, then a second press on Attach link if there is one. P0: Attach link and nothing picked, a press on the row's Attach link, then Escape. CT: every button on screen above y 400 with the block selected. Real mouse presses and keys. R1 ran P1, P2, P0, CT and R2 P0, P2, P1, CT. Nothing saved: each session left by Exit Without Saving. The probe and reads of CAP-T12LINKKEYS.
readsAre: As CAP-T12LINKKEYS: block (the Scrolling block's state and desktop area, link its data-link-to), pop (field: the link editor's field value and place, or null when it is closed; options: the page list's rows shown; linkRow: the panel's Link row), focus (where the focus is: top page or frame, tag, label or text, value, box), undo (Save, Undo, Redo and whether each is off). CT toolbar: [document, aria-label, title, text, left, top] of each button.
answer: P1 and P2: after a pick the row reads Attach link with the editor open; a press on it closes the editor (field null) and the row shows the link: About, /about, Edit, Copy, Remove Link. The editor does not open again, and the focus is on the row's Edit button. There is no Attach link left to press a second time (P2). Escape then lets the block go and the panel closes (P1).

P0: with nothing picked, a press on the row's Attach link leaves the editor open on its empty field with the page list (6 rows) and the focus in the field; the row still reads Attach link. Escape then takes the page list and the editor stays open, as CAP-T12LINKZ Z10 read.
CT: a selected Scrolling block's toolbar is Edit, Align Vertically, Pin, Duplicate, Remove. It has no Link button, so no link editor opens from it.
R1 and R2 read alike in every read (the block ids apart). The scenario P1's last step, a press on Content after the Escape, found no Content: the panel had closed (recorded as its error).
Not read: a press on Attach link after Cmd+Z took the pick; the keyboard (Enter or Space) on the held button; other block kinds.

localGuesses.written: none written before the reads; ours on main closes the editor and shows the row too, the focus left on the page
